scripts.build: cd packages/mcp && npm run build && cd ../tui && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build && cd ../.. && npm run build:workers
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:shrinkwrap && npm run check:oracle-version && npm run check:surface-coverage && npm run check:inline-test-ports && npm run check:source-anchors && npm run check:english-prose && npm run check:triage-ledger && npm run check:behavior-evidence && npm run check:manifest && tsgo --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only
scripts.version:major: npm version major -ws --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.publish: npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish -ws --access public
scripts.publish:dry: npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish -ws --access public --dry-run
scripts.test:raw: PI_NO_LOCAL_LLM=1 npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:workers
